descripcion:
EN VIVO Tycoon es un juego de gestión: empiezas en un garaje con una vieja cámara y creces hasta transmitir la gran final del campeonato.

ARMA TU PRODUCTORA
• Acepta eventos: cumpleaños, conciertos, partidos, conferencias y más.
• Compra y mejora cámaras, luces, audio y vehículos.
• Contrata y entrena a tu equipo.

RESUELVE IMPREVISTOS
En cada evento pasa algo: se rompe un cable, se cae el internet, llueve o se va la luz. Tú decides cómo resolverlo y cada decisión cuenta.

CRECE Y COMPITE
• Sube de nivel, desbloquea nuevos lugares y eventos más grandes.
• Misiones diarias, temporadas y logros.

La partida se guarda sola. Hecho en Ecuador por Tukán Software, inspirado en el trabajo real de las productoras de transmisiones en vivo.
texto_promocional: Empieza en un garaje y llega a transmitir la gran final. ¡Resuelve los imprevistos en vivo!
notas_revisor:
1. Screen recording (physical iPhone, latest iOS): {video}

2. Purpose and audience: EN VIVO Tycoon is a management/simulation game for teens and adults: the player runs a live-event production company (cameras, lights, audio, crew) and solves on-air problems during events. Made in Ecuador by Tukán Software.

3. How to use it: the game can be played without an account. Open the app, follow the short tutorial and tap "Jugar". Accept events, buy equipment with in-game coins, hire crew and solve incidents. An account is optional (to save progress in the cloud, and it is required to buy so purchases are kept): it can be created and deleted inside the app from Tienda > Tu cuenta > "Borrar mi cuenta" (also at https://juego.tukanec.com/borrar-cuenta.html). The player chat (red chat button) has a report option on every message; reporting a message also blocks that player. Players can also report another player from Soporte > "Reportar a un jugador".

4. External services and in-app purchases: our own game server (juego.tukanec.com) for cloud save, leaderboards and chat. No third-party analytics, no ads, no AI services. The app now offers optional in-app purchases sold only with Apple In-App Purchase (StoreKit 2): consumables (credit packs, season/weekly passes, VIP 30 days, offers) and non-consumables (one-time packs such as "Oferta de bienvenida" and "Paquete de inicio"). No other payment method or external purchase link is shown on iPhone. Our server delivers each item after verifying the signed Apple transaction. How to test: sign in or create a free account (Tienda > Tu cuenta), then bottom tab "Tienda" > "Créditos" (also "Ofertas", "VIP" and "Pase") and tap "Comprar". "Restaurar compras" is at the bottom of the Tienda. Everything in the game can also be earned by playing for free.

5. Regional differences: none. The game works the same in every region (Spanish and English).

6. Regulated industry / third-party material: not applicable. All art, names and content are original.
